WHAT WE MANUFACTURE

Every part, every process.

From raw pattern to finished component — bearings, rotating parts and structural fabrication, made to your drawing or sample.

01

White Metal Bearings

Precision-poured white metal (babbitt) bearings manufactured to size for industrial machinery and engines.

02

Pistons

Pistons manufactured to exact bore and tolerance specifications for a range of engine and pump applications.

03

Piston Cylinders

Cylinder liners and piston cylinder assemblies machined and finished to fit specification.

04

Metalization

Metal spray coating services for worn shafts, housings and components — restoring dimension and wear resistance.

05

Wheels — All Types

Cast and fabricated wheels of various sizes and profiles for industrial and material-handling use.

06

Impellers

Impellers cast and machined for pumps and blowers, built to your existing sample or drawing.

07

General Fabrication

Every type of steel fabrication work — structural, custom brackets, frames and job-work fabrication.

08

Steel & C.I. Casting

In-house steel and cast iron (C.I.) foundry work for components of any size or shape.

09

Pattern Making

All types of wooden and metal patterns made in-house, for use in our own foundry or supplied separately.

ABOUT THE WORKSHOP

A full-service foundry and fabrication shop.

Shiv Foundry runs pattern making, casting, machining, metalization and fabrication as one connected process — so a component can go from a wooden pattern to a finished, fitted part without leaving our workshop.

We work directly from customer drawings, samples, or worn parts that need to be reverse-manufactured, and take on both one-off jobs and repeat production runs.

  • 01 Pattern to casting, handled in-house
  • 02 Steel and cast iron foundry capability
  • 03 Custom sizes made to drawing or sample
  • 04 Metalization for worn-part restoration
  • 05 Fabrication and machining under one roof
